# Videoguys

> > Videoguys is a professional video production and broadcast equipment retailer offering cameras, storage solutions, encoders, switchers, networking gear, and audio interfaces for content creators and AV professionals.

Videoguys specializes in professional-grade video production equipment from leading manufacturers including Panasonic, Glyph, Atomos, Roland, Teradek, NETGEAR, and Avid. The company serves broadcast professionals, content creators, and educational institutions with solutions for 4K/HDR video production, secure storage, live streaming, and AV-over-IP networking.

## Key Topics

- 4K Video Production
- Professional Storage (Glyph SecureDrive+, SSD)
- Hardware Encryption (XTS-AES 256-bit)
- AV-over-IP Networking
- NDI (Network Device Interface)
- PTZ Cameras (Panasonic)
- Live Stream Encoders (Epiphan, Roland)
- HDMI Video Switching
- PoE+ Managed Switches (NETGEAR)
- Wireless Video Transmission (Teradek)
- CFExpress & Memory Cards
- Thunderbolt 3 & USB-C Connectivity
- Audio Interfaces (MOTU)
- Avid Pro Tools & Media Composer
- Q-SYS Audio Networking
